linker: Preorder[0] is Root + HashMap {val: inorder_idx} finds root split in O(1); recursively build left (in_left..mid-1) and right (mid+1..in_right)

title: Last Stone Weight
trigger: Repeatedly smash the 2 heaviest stones together and push difference back
linker: Max-Heap (push -weight in Python): pop two smallest (most negative) y, x; if y != x push -(y - x) back into heap

title: Surrounded Regions
pattern: Boundary Reverse DFS/BFS (Flood Fill from Edges)
trigger: Capture all 'O' regions 4-directionally surrounded by 'X' (regions touching border cannot be captured)
linker: Reverse Thinking: run DFS/BFS from all 'O's on the 4 borders and mark them 'T' (safe); then flip remaining 'O'->'X' and 'T'->'O'

title: Reconstruct Itinerary
trigger: Use every airline ticket (directed edge) exactly once, starting at 'JFK' in lexical order
linker: Adjacency List with sorted Min-Heaps/Lists + Post-order DFS: pop smallest neighbor greedily, and append node to itinerary ONLY when stuck, then reverse!

title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
trigger: Find longest strictly increasing path in 2D matrix moving 4-directionally
linker: Because path is strictly increasing, there are NO cycles (it's a DAG)! Run DFS(r, c) + @lru_cache checking 4 neighbors where matrix[nr][nc] > matrix[r][c]

title: Hand of Straights
pattern: Greedy Frequency Map + Min-Heap / Sorted Keys
trigger: Partition cards into groups of size W where each group consists of W consecutive numbers
linker: Counter + Min-Heap/Sorted unique cards: always start a run from the smallest available card x, and decrement counts for x, x+1, ..., x+W-1

title: Merge Triplets to Form Target Triplet
trigger: Max-merge triplets [a,b,c] to reach target [x,y,z]
linker: Filter out any triplet where a > x or b > y or c > z (would ruin target); among remaining safe triplets, check if x, y, and z each appear at least once

title: Valid Parenthesis String
trigger: Parentheses string with '(' , ')' and wildcard '*' (can be '(', ')' or empty)
linker: Two Greedy Counters (leftMin, leftMax): '(' increments both, ')' decrements both, '*' decrements leftMin & increments leftMax; clamp leftMin = max(0, leftMin)

title: Meeting Rooms
trigger: Determine if a person could attend all meetings (no overlapping intervals)
linker: Sort intervals by start time: loop i from 1..n-1 and check if intervals[i].start < intervals[i-1].end

title: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query
trigger: For each query point q, find the smallest interval [L, R] (by length R-L+1) covering q
linker: Sort intervals by L and sort queries (preserving original index) + Min-Heap [(size, R)]: push all intervals with L <= q, pop expired with R < q, top is answer!

title: Rotate Image
trigger: Rotate N x N 2D matrix 90 degrees clockwise in-place
linker: Step 1: Transpose across diagonal (swap matrix[r][c] with matrix[c][r]); Step 2: Reverse each row left-to-right with Two Pointers

title: Spiral Matrix
trigger: Return all elements of M x N matrix in clockwise spiral order
linker: 4 Boundary Pointers (top, bottom, left, right): traverse top row -> top++, right col -> right--, bottom row -> bottom--, left col -> left++

title: Set Matrix Zeroes
trigger: If matrix[r][c] == 0, set its entire row and column to 0 in O(1) extra space
linker: Use first row matrix[0][c] and first col matrix[r][0] as boolean flags + 1 extra boolean rowZero for row 0 itself

title: Plus One
trigger: Increment large integer represented as array of digits by 1
linker: Loop backwards from n-1 down to 0: if digits[i] < 9 increment and return immediately; else set digits[i] = 0. If loop finishes, return [1] + digits

title: Pow(x, n)
trigger: Compute x raised to power n in O(log n) time (handle negative n)
linker: Divide & Conquer / Bitwise: if n < 0 do x = 1/x, n = -n; square x and halve n (n //= 2) at each step, multiplying result when n is odd

title: Detect Squares
trigger: Add 2D points to stream and count axis-aligned squares formed with query point (px, py)
linker: HashMap {(x, y): count}: iterate over all points (x, y) where abs(px - x) == abs(py - y) and px != x (diagonal corner), then multiply counts of (x, py) and (px, y)

title: Pascal's Triangle
trigger: Generate first numRows of Pascal's triangle where each number is sum of two numbers above it
linker: 2D List: each row starts and ends with 1; inner element row[j] = prev_row[j-1] + prev_row[j]

title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays Without Extra Space
trigger: Merge nums2 into nums1 in-place without overwriting unread elements of nums1
linker: 3 Pointers starting from the END (p1 = m-1, p2 = n-1, write_idx = m+n-1): place larger of nums1[p1] and nums2[p2] at write_idx--

title: Repeat and Missing Number
pattern: Math Sum/Square Equations or XOR Buckets
trigger: In 1..N array/grid, one number appears twice (R) and one is missing (M); find both in O(1) space
linker: Math: compute S - S_expected = R - M and S2 - S2_expected = R^2 - M^2 = (R-M)(R+M), solve for R and M (or use Cyclic Sort / XOR)

title: Count Inversions in an Array (Merge Sort)
trigger: Count pairs (i < j) such that nums[i] > 2 * nums[j] (or Count Inversions where nums[i] > nums[j])
linker: Merge Sort: before merging sorted left and right halves, use a two-pointer scan across left & right to count valid pairs in O(N), total O(N log N)

title: Majority Element (> N/2 times)
trigger: Find element appearing strictly more than N/2 times in O(N) time and O(1) space
linker: Candidate + Count variables: if count == 0 pick candidate = num; if num == candidate count += 1 else count -= 1

title: Majority Element II (> N/3 times)
trigger: Find all elements appearing strictly more than floor(N/3) times in O(1) space
linker: At most 2 elements can appear > N/3 times! Track (cand1, cnt1) and (cand2, cnt2), then do a 2nd pass to verify actual counts > N//3

title: Count Number of Subarrays with Given XOR K
trigger: Count subarrays with XOR equal to K (or reconstruct prefix XOR)
linker: Prefix XOR Running Value + HashMap {xor_val: count}: since A ^ B = K implies A = B ^ K, check seen_map[curr_xor ^ K] at each index

title: Max Consecutive Ones
trigger: Find maximum number of consecutive 1s in a binary array
linker: Single Pass + curr_streak, max_streak: if num == 1 increment curr_streak and update max; else reset curr_streak = 0

title: M-Coloring Problem
trigger: Color graph nodes with at most M colors so no two adjacent nodes share the same color
linker: Adjacency List + Backtracking DFS(node): try color c in 1..M; if no neighbor has color c, assign color[node]=c and recurse to node+1

title: Rat in a Maze
trigger: Find paths from start to end in a grid with obstacles, visiting valid empty squares
linker: Grid DFS(r, c) + Visited Mask/In-Place '#' Marker: mark cell visited, recurse 4 directions (D, L, R, U), then unmark on backtrack

title: The N-th Root of an Integer
pattern: Binary Search on Monotonic Function (Nth Root)
trigger: Find integer square root or N-th root of M without built-in pow
linker: Binary Search in [1, M]: check mid^N <= M; if so lo = mid + 1 (save ans = mid), else hi = mid - 1

title: Find the Element that Appears Once in a Sorted Array
pattern: Binary Search on Even/Odd Index Parity
trigger: Sorted array where every element appears twice except one; find single element in O(log N)
linker: Before the single element, pairs start at EVEN index (nums[even] == nums[even+1]). Force mid to be even (mid ^= 1): if nums[mid] == nums[mid+1], single is on right (lo = mid + 2), else hi = mid

title: Implement Stack Using Arrays
trigger: Implement Push, Pop, Top, Size using a fixed/dynamic array or simulate stack operations
linker: Array + top_index pointer: push increments top_index and writes value; pop decrements top_index in O(1)

title: Next Smaller Element
trigger: For each item i, find the first item j > i with price[j] <= price[i]
linker: Monotonic Increasing Stack of indices: when prices[i] <= prices[stack[-1]], pop idx and set ans[idx] incorporating prices[i]

title: The Celebrity Problem
trigger: Celebrity knows nobody, but everyone knows the celebrity; find in O(N) calls to knows(a, b)
linker: Pass 1 (Elimination): candidate = 0; for i in 1..n-1: if knows(candidate, i) candidate = i. Pass 2: verify candidate knows no one and everyone knows candidate

title: Rabin Karp Algorithm
pattern: Rabin-Karp Rolling Hash / KMP Substring Match
trigger: Minimum times string A must be repeated so that string B is a substring of it
linker: Repeat A until len >= len(B) (q = ceil(len(B)/len(A))); check if B in A*q or A*(q+1) using Rabin-Karp rolling hash or KMP

title: Compare Version Numbers
trigger: Compare two version strings like '1.01' and '1.001.0' revision by revision
linker: Split by '.' (or scan with 2 pointers): loop i from 0 to max(len1, len2)-1, parse int(v1[i]) (default 0 if out of bounds) and compare

title: Root to Node Path in a Binary Tree
trigger: Find path from root to a target node or all root-to-leaf paths in a Binary Tree
linker: DFS(node, path): append node.val to path; if leaf/target reached record path; recurse left & right; path.pop() on backtrack

title: Max Width of a Binary Tree
trigger: Max width among all levels, where width includes null nodes between leftmost and rightmost non-null nodes
linker: BFS Queue storing (node, index): left child gets 2*idx, right child gets 2*idx + 1; level width = last_idx - first_idx + 1

title: Construct Binary Tree from Inorder and Postorder
pattern: Divide & Conquer (Postorder Root from End) + HashMap
trigger: Rebuild binary tree from inorder (L, Root, R) and postorder (L, R, Root) arrays
linker: Postorder.pop() gives Root + HashMap {val: inorder_idx}; IMPORTANT: build RIGHT subtree first (mid+1..right), then LEFT subtree (left..mid-1)!

title: Check for Children Sum Property
trigger: Check or modify binary tree so every node's value equals the sum of its left and right children
linker: DFS Traversal: going down, if child_sum < root.val set children = root.val; going back up (post-order), set root.val = left.val + right.val

title: Search Given Key in BST
trigger: Find node in BST with val == target in O(H) time and O(1) space
linker: While curr: if target == curr.val return curr; elif target < curr.val curr = curr.left; else curr = curr.right

title: Find the Inorder Predecessor/Successor of a Given Key in BST
trigger: Find the node with the smallest key strictly greater than p.val in a BST in O(H) time
linker: Initialize successor = None; while root: if p.val < root.val: successor = root; root = root.left else: root = root.right

title: Floor and Ceil in a BST
trigger: Find Floor (largest <= key), Ceil (smallest >= key), or closest value in BST in O(H)
linker: Walk down BST: if root.val == key return; if root.val < key update floor = root.val and go right; else update ceil = root.val and go left

title: BST Iterator
trigger: Implement next() and hasNext() on BST in average O(1) time and O(H) memory
linker: Explicit Stack + pushAllLeft(node) helper: init calls pushAllLeft(root); next() pops top node, calls pushAllLeft(node.right), and returns node.val

title: Size of the Largest BST in a Binary Tree
trigger: Find largest BST (by size or sum) inside an arbitrary Binary Tree
linker: Post-Order DFS returns (is_bst, min_val, max_val, size_or_sum): node is valid BST iff left.is_bst and right.is_bst and left.max < node.val < right.min

title: Distinct Numbers in Window
trigger: Count distinct elements in every window of size K (or max sum of K-window with distinct elements)
linker: HashMap {val: count} + Window [L..R]: add nums[R] to map; when R - L + 1 == K, len(map) is distinct count; decrement nums[L] (delete key if count == 0) and L++

title: Maximum Sum Increasing Subsequence
trigger: Find subsequence of strictly increasing elements that maximizes the SUM (instead of length)
linker: 1D DP Array dp[i] = nums[i]: for j in 0..i-1, if nums[j] < nums[i]: dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + nums[i])

title: Egg Dropping
pattern: Minimax DP with Binary Search (or Moves-Based DP)
trigger: Minimum worst-case moves to find critical floor F using K eggs and N floors
linker: DP by Moves: dp[m][k] = max floors testable with m moves and k eggs = 1 + dp[m-1][k-1] (breaks) + dp[m-1][k] (survives); increment m until dp[m][K] >= N

title: Longest String with All Prefixes
trigger: Find longest word in dictionary such that EVERY prefix of the word is also in the dictionary
linker: Insert all words into Trie; run DFS/BFS only along Trie children where child.is_word == True

title: Number of Distinct Substrings in a String
trigger: Count total number of distinct substrings of string s
linker: Loop start index i from 0..n-1 and insert s[i:] into a Trie; every time you create a NEW TrieNode, increment distinct_count += 1

title: Maximum XOR With an Element From Array
trigger: For each query (x_i, m_i), find max(x_i ^ num) among all nums[j] <= m_i
linker: Sort nums ascending and sort queries by m_i ascending + Bitwise Trie: insert all nums[j] <= m_i into 32-bit Trie, then greedily walk opposite bits of x_i
